test_cases.name: Verbose quote request for multiple items
test_cases.description: A recognized customer requests a quote for several catalog items, providing detailed context and rationale for the request. The email is verbose and neutral, establishing the business context for a quote lifecycle. No ambiguity or intervention is present; all items are from the available catalog. The customer does not confirm the quote or request order creation yet.

initial_turn.subject: Request for Quote: Toy Sets and Apparel for Upcoming Event
initial_turn.body:
Hello,

I am reaching out on behalf of Chevy Toys to request a formal quote for several items that we are considering for our upcoming promotional event. We are looking to source a mix of toys and apparel to create bundled gift packs for our attendees. Specifically, please include the following items in the quote:

- 10 units of the JoySprout Toy Car Set
- 15 units of the SmartToys Building Blocks
- 20 units of T-Shirt (Item No: AITEM-0025)
- 5 units of the WonderWagon Bicycle

If there are any volume discounts or special pricing available for bulk orders, please let us know. We would appreciate a breakdown of the pricing for each item and any relevant terms regarding delivery timelines or payment options. This quote will help us finalize our selections and quantities before proceeding to the next step.

Best regards,
Larry King

test_cases.name: Verbose Quote Request for Multiple Items
test_cases.description: A polite and detailed customer email from Rachel Green requesting a quote for several catalog items, providing extra context and explanations, as is typical for a verbose persona. The email establishes the business context and requests a quote, setting up for a later order confirmation in a follow-up turn.

initial_turn.subject: Request for Detailed Quote on Selected Items
initial_turn.body:
Dear Sales Team,

I hope this message finds you well. My name is Rachel Green, and I am reaching out on behalf of WonderToys Co. as we are currently planning our upcoming product launch event and need to procure several items for both display and demonstration purposes. To ensure we stay within our budget and timelines, I would appreciate it if you could provide a detailed quote for the following products from your catalog:

- 3 units of the MagicToyland Fairy Doll. These will be used as part of our interactive play area, so please include any relevant warranty or care information in the quote if possible.
- 2 T-Shirts. We noticed there are several T-Shirt options listed in your catalog, but we are not sure which would be most suitable for our staff uniforms. Could you please include the available options or clarify which T-Shirts you recommend for this purpose?
- 1 WonderWagon Pull-Along Train, as we would like to feature this in our main display section.

If you require any additional information from our side to prepare the quote, please let me know. We are aiming to finalize our selections soon, so a prompt response would be greatly appreciated. Thank you in advance for your assistance and attention to detail.

Best regards,
Rachel Green

initial_turn.subject: Looking for a quote on a few items for our upcoming event
initial_turn.body:
Hey there,

Hope you're doing well! We're gearing up for our annual Toytopia Family Day, and we're looking to get a quote on a few products that have been popular with our customers in the past. Just want to make sure we have everything lined up before the big day.

Here's what we're interested in:
- 2 sets of the GiggleGear Action Figures Set (these were a hit last year, so we're hoping to get them again)
- 5 units of the SmartToys Jigsaw Puzzle Set (we're planning a puzzle corner for the kids)
- 3 T-Shirts (we've ordered these before, but I don't recall if there are different styles or colors—can you let me know what options are available or just quote the standard ones?)

If you need any more details from our side, just let me know. We're hoping to get this quote soon so we can finalize our event planning. Thanks a ton for your help!

Best,
Toytopia

Best regards,
Toytopia
